summary: Central North Airport Group (OMA) filed a Form 6-K reporting a debt placement of Ps.3.0 billion in two tranches: Ps.420 million 3-year variable-rate notes (TIIE de Fondeo plus 39 bp) and Ps.2,580 million 7-year fixed-rate notes (9.17%). Both tranches received AAA ratings from Fitch and Moody's Local. Proceeds will prepay Ps.1.7 billion in short-term loans and Ps.640 million of OMA 23L certificates, with remainder for investments and working capital. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction—not a special situation. Settlement is July 20, 2026.
